title: Chapter 278 The Burning Legion
content:
Chapter 278 The Burning Legion

The intensity of the battle decreased.

Wang Shuo did not take it lightly. The short pause was to brew a bigger storm.

In the distance, beyond the range that Wang Shuo could not observe.

A huge altar was filled with a strong aura of death.

Next to the altar, an undead knight with raging clothes and burning flames all over his body, holding a burning sword, quietly stared at the skeleton warrior who slowly walked out of the altar.

The most bizarre thing was that his tattered cloak and clothes were not burned to ashes by the flames, but rustled in the wind.

The firelight penetrated the chest and skull, looking horrible and terrifying, as if from hell.

And behind him, there were hundreds of skeleton warriors like him.

He suddenly turned around and looked in the direction of Wana Town, and saw that the undead beasts were dead and injured.

"Waste." A hoarse voice, with a strong contempt.

Then, he blew a whistle, summoned an undead warhorse, rode on the horse's back, and the warhorse also burned with flames.

He raised the burning bone sword with his right hand, which was only a skeleton, and shouted loudly.

"Burning Legion, invincible!"

"Burning Legion! Invincible!"

About half of the skeletons around also mounted their horses, and all the skeletons shouted loudly with broken voices.

The sounds of ghosts crying and wolves howling came one after another.

Wang Shuo also faintly heard the sound, and felt a little uneasy.

At this time, the air of death was all around Wana Town, which reminded Wang Shuo of the situation in the Dragon King's underground palace.

Obviously, the situation at this time was much more serious.

Fortunately, with the protection of the dead soul beads, the people of Wana Town are still in very good condition.

Not long after, the undead burning legion of Black Dragon City rushed over on undead bone horses.

The number of this undead cavalry was not large, only more than 500 people, but there were almost 1,000 skeleton infantry behind them.

Wang Shuo scouted and found a skeleton general in the lead.

[Hazamu (gold boss) Junior Commander of the Burning Legion]

[Level: Level 55]

[Attack: 1200]

[Defense: 800]

[HP: 18000]

[Skills: Sweep the Troops, Charged Attack, Hellfire. ]

There was only gold, and there was only one boss, which made Wang Shuo feel relieved.

Although the levels of other skeleton warriors were also over 50, it was not beyond Wang Shuo's expectations.

Thinking about it, the Undead Legion was attacking all villages, towns and cities, and each village should have a boss, so he was relieved.

If each village had several bosses, the strength of the entire Undead Legion would be too terrible.

Finally, they were not targeted this time.

Wang Shuo came to his senses and quickly ordered all the troops to prepare for battle.

At present, the only long-range siege undead Wang Shuo encountered were the previous giant slingers.

The destructive power on the city wall is limited. The undead knights and skeleton warriors who rushed over can only use the weapons in their hands to continuously chop at the city wall.

Although it seems that there is not much harm, the attack power of these skeleton warriors is completely beyond the reach of the undead beasts just now.

This made Wang Shuo a little surprised. Why was the undead beast just now so weak?

Of course, compared with these skeleton warriors with hundreds of attack power.

Now is not the time to think about these problems. Various attacks are pouring down on the skeletons.

At the same time, the durability of the city wall is also constantly decreasing.

98%...97%...

When it dropped to 67%, the undead army under the city wall finally couldn't hold on.

They began to retreat.

Wang Shuo's eyes widened.

They actually know how to retreat?

Hazamu led the remaining hundreds of undead legions and retreated to the side of the altar.

At this time, he stood still, as if he was talking to someone.

"Reporting to the commander, my subordinates were frustrated in their attack on Wana Town."

"You are useless. You can't even break through a small town built by a player. I will give you one more day. If you still can't take it down, I will put out your nether fire."

"Yes. Commander."
